boundary: UserEdit.save is the commit-point region. On the add path (isAdd()==true), JPAUserManagerImpl.addUser's own existence checks (getUsers at :164, getUserByUserName at :176-177, and the cache-hit getUser it calls) all run via getEntityManager(false) before addUser's own strategy.store(newUser) call (:181); the lazy JPA transaction only begins at that store, continues through the editor/admin role grants inside addUser and the admin-role grant/revoke back in UserEdit.save, and commits at WebloggerFactory.getWeblogger().flush() (UserEdit.java:112). On the edit path, saveUser's strategy.store(user) (JPAUserManagerImpl.java:70-72) is itself the first write and begins the transaction; user was already loaded (as a managed entity) by myPrepare() in an earlier phase of the request, outside this root's call tree, so that earlier load is not one of this root's operations.

ops_remove.note: getUsers (JPAUserManagerImpl.java:164, via addUser) runs through getEntityManager(false) before addUser's own strategy.store(newUser) at line 181; per the app's lazy-begin rule (calibration.md:10-11) this read auto-commits before the region's first write and is outside the boundary.
getUserByUserName (JPAUserManagerImpl.java:176-177, via addUser) likewise runs before addUser's store(newUser) at line 181; outside the boundary for the same reason as op 2.
JPAPersistenceStrategy.load (the cache-hit path inside getUserByUserName, JPAUserManagerImpl.java:265) is reached only from the same pre-store calls as op 9, so it is also before the region begins.

getWeblogPermission (JPAUserManagerImpl.java:383-394) only runs on the `perm instanceof WeblogPermission` branch of checkPermission (:362); the only call to checkPermission from this root is UserEdit.save:200 with adminPerm = new GlobalPermission(...) (UserEdit.java:196-197/199-200), and GlobalPermission (pojos/GlobalPermission.java:36, extends RollerPermission) is unrelated to WeblogPermission (pojos/WeblogPermission.java:34, extends ObjectPermission), so the instanceof check is always false here and this branch is dead on this path.
getWeblogByHandle's named-query path (JPAWeblogManagerImpl.java:409), reached only through the dead WeblogPermission branch removed as op 5.
getWeblogByHandle's cache-hit load (JPAPersistenceStrategy.java:223, via JPAWeblogManagerImpl.getWeblog), reached only through the same dead WeblogPermission branch as ops 5 and 10.

notes: After removing the dead WeblogPermission branch and the pre-store reads inside addUser, the kept operations are: op1 revokeRole's UserRole read, op3 the store() that begins the transaction (persist on add, dirty-check update on edit), op4 getRoles (userrole, via the GlobalPermission(user) admin check), op6 revokeRole's remove, op7 hasRole's read (via grantRole), op8 grantRole's persist -- all genuinely inside the transaction.
